setup.en: Use a mat on a firm floor. This is a small trunk curl, not a full sit-up; keep the feet unanchored.
setup.zh: 在结实地面铺垫子。这是小幅卷腹，双脚不固定，不需要坐起来。

steps.en: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat about hip-width apart, and arms reaching towards your thighs. Let the low back keep a comfortable small curve.
steps.zh: 仰卧，屈膝，双脚与髋大致同宽踩地，双臂伸向大腿。腰背保留舒适的小弧度。

steps.en: Look upwards and leave space between chin and chest. Gently firm the abdominal wall without holding your breath.
steps.zh: 眼睛看上方，下巴与胸口之间留出空间。腹壁稍收紧，保持呼吸。

steps.en: Breathe out and bring the lower ribs towards the pelvis, lifting the head and upper shoulder blades a small distance together.
steps.zh: 呼气，把下位肋骨带向骨盆，头和上部肩胛骨一起稍稍离地。

steps.en: Stop while the feet and pelvis stay still. The hands slide towards the knees; do not turn it into a sit-up.
steps.zh: 在双脚和骨盆仍稳定的位置停下。手向膝盖方向滑，不要继续坐起。

steps.en: Breathe in and lower the upper back and head gently onto the mat. Reset the neck before the next movement.
steps.zh: 吸气，把上背和头轻轻放回垫上，再检查颈部是否放松。

cues.en: Curl the ribs towards the belt line.
cues.zh: 把肋骨卷向腰带的位置。

cues.en: Feel the front abdominal wall working; keep the neck comfortable.
cues.zh: 体会腹前壁用力，颈部保持舒适。

mistakes.en: Pulling the chin into the chest. Why: neck movement replaces part of the trunk curl and can make the neck uncomfortable.
mistakes.zh: 把下巴猛收向胸口。为什么：颈部运动替代了部分卷腹，也可能让颈部不适。

mistakes.en: Rising all the way to sitting. Why: the task changes and the hip flexors contribute more, rather than staying with a small trunk curl.
mistakes.zh: 一直卷到坐起。为什么：任务改变，髋屈肌参与更多，不再是小幅躯干前屈。

text.en: Choose a small range that you can reverse smoothly without pulling on the head.
text.zh: 选能平稳返回的小幅度，不靠拉头完成。

text.en: Build control before adding more work, and recover before another hard abdominal session.
text.zh: 先练会控制，再增加训练量；腹部练得很累后，充分恢复再练。

cautions.en: Stop if the movement brings on neck or back pain; do not force a bigger curl.
cautions.zh: 动作引起颈部或背部疼痛就停下，不要勉强卷得更高。

cautions.en: First learn with bodyweight or a light load and guidance from a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

text.en: Vispute, Smith, LeCheminant and Hurley (2011) studied twenty-four sedentary adults in an abdominal-training or control group over six weeks. Curl-up endurance improved, but abdominal-fat measures did not fall significantly; this was a programme of several exercises, not a test of this curl-up alone.
text.zh: Vispute、Smith、LeCheminant 和 Hurley（2011）将 24 名久坐成年人分到腹部训练组或对照组，观察 6 周。卷腹耐力提高了，腹部脂肪相关测量却没有显著下降。研究用的是多个动作组成的方案，不是单独测试这里的卷腹。

setup.en: Lie on a mat with space to reach an arm and the opposite leg. Start with a short reach; a heel slide is an easier learning version.
setup.zh: 仰卧在垫上，留出伸手和伸对侧腿的空间。先伸短一点；脚跟沿地面滑动是更容易的学习版本。

steps.en: Raise the arms over the chest and lift the thighs so hips and knees are bent about a right angle. Keep the head resting.
steps.zh: 双臂举到胸口上方，抬起大腿，髋和膝大致屈成直角，头留在垫上。

steps.en: Gently brace and breathe out. Keep the pelvis still and the low back in a comfortable position close to the mat.
steps.zh: 腹部稍收紧并呼气。骨盆不动，下背在贴近垫面的舒适位置。

steps.en: Slowly reach the left arm towards the floor behind the head while extending the right leg forwards and down. The other limbs stay still.
steps.zh: 左臂慢慢向头后方地面伸，右腿同时向前下方伸直，另外两肢不动。

steps.en: Stop before the ribs lift or the low back arches further. The hand and heel need not touch the floor. Continue a quiet breath.
steps.zh: 在肋骨翘起、下背进一步弓起之前停下。手和脚跟不必碰地，仍能平缓呼吸。

steps.en: Return the left arm and right leg to the start under control, then practise the opposite pair with the same still pelvis.
steps.zh: 有控制地收回左臂和右腿，再换另一组对侧肢体，骨盆同样保持稳定。

cues.en: Reach only as far as the pelvis stays quiet.
cues.zh: 只伸到骨盆还能不动的位置。

cues.en: Feel a broad abdominal effort rather than a pinch in the low back.
cues.zh: 腹壁整体用力，下背不应有夹痛。

mistakes.en: Dropping the heel low after the back starts arching. Why: the longer lever is exceeding the control of the trunk.
mistakes.zh: 腰开始弓起后，还继续把脚跟放低。为什么：力臂已经超过了躯干能控制的程度。

mistakes.en: Moving both legs quickly. Why: momentum makes it harder to control the pelvis and hides the loss of position.
mistakes.zh: 双腿一起快速甩动。为什么：惯性让骨盆更难控制，也掩盖了姿势变化。

text.en: Shorten the reach until the pelvis stays still and breathing remains comfortable.
text.zh: 先缩短伸展距离，让骨盆不动、呼吸舒适。

text.en: Increase the reach gradually before adding resistance or more work.
text.zh: 先逐渐延长伸展距离，再考虑加阻力或训练量。

cautions.en: Stop for back pain or a pinching feeling at the front of the hip.
cautions.zh: 下背痛或髋前方有夹痛感时停下。

cautions.en: First learn with bodyweight or a light load and guidance from a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Use a non-slip mat. Learn with the knees supported if the full position is difficult.
setup.zh: 用防滑垫。完整姿势较难时，先让膝盖着地。

steps.en: Set the forearms on the mat, elbows below the shoulders and bent about a right angle. Keep hands relaxed and parallel.
steps.zh: 前臂放在垫上，两肘在肩下，大致屈成直角；双手放松，前臂平行。

steps.en: Extend the legs and place the toes on the floor, with feet about hip-width apart. Push gently through the forearms.
steps.zh: 伸直双腿，脚趾撑地，双脚与髋大致同宽，前臂轻轻推地。

steps.en: Lift the knees and set a long line through head, trunk and heels. Gently firm the abdomen and buttocks without lifting the hips high.
steps.zh: 膝盖离地，从头、躯干到脚跟保持长直线。腹部和臀部稍收紧，不要把臀部抬很高。

steps.en: Hold the same shape while taking quiet breaths. Keep the ribs above the pelvis rather than letting the waist sag.
steps.zh: 平缓呼吸，维持同样形状。肋骨与骨盆保持对齐，不让腰腹下塌。

steps.en: Finish before the shape changes: lower the knees gently, then rest the abdomen and forearms.
steps.zh: 姿势开始改变前结束：先轻放膝盖，再放松腹部和前臂。

cues.en: Keep the belt line from dropping towards the mat.
cues.zh: 腰带的位置不要往垫子方向掉。

cues.en: Press the mat away without bringing the shoulders to the ears.
cues.zh: 把垫子推开，但肩膀不要往耳朵靠。

cues.en: Keep breathing; a still body is still working.
cues.zh: 保持呼吸；身体不动，肌肉仍在工作。

mistakes.en: Sagging through the waist. Why: the lumbar spine extends while the task is to resist that extension.
mistakes.zh: 腰腹下塌。为什么：腰椎开始后伸，而本动作要练的是抵抗这种后伸。

mistakes.en: Piking the hips to keep going. Why: it shortens the lever and changes the exercise instead of maintaining the original line.
mistakes.zh: 撑不住时把臀部高高抬起。为什么：这缩短了力臂，改变了任务，已没有维持原来的直线。

text.en: Use a supported version that allows steady breathing and a consistent body line.
text.zh: 选能平稳呼吸、保持身体直线的支撑版本。

text.en: End the hold when control fades, then progress gradually with practice and recovery.
text.zh: 控制开始减弱就结束，随练习和恢复逐步进阶。

cautions.en: Stop for shoulder, elbow or back pain; use the knee-supported version only if it is comfortable.
cautions.zh: 肩、肘或背部疼痛就停下；膝盖着地的版本也要以舒适为前提。

cautions.en: First learn with bodyweight or a light load and guidance from a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Lie on the right side on a non-slip mat. Resist side bending and rolling; begin with bent-knee support if the straight-leg version is too demanding.
setup.zh: 在防滑垫上右侧卧，抵抗侧弯和翻转；双腿伸直较难时，先用屈膝支撑。

steps.en: Set the right elbow directly below the shoulder, forearm pointing forwards, and place the left hand on the hip.
steps.zh: 右肘放在右肩正下方，前臂向前，左手放在髋上。

steps.en: Straighten the legs with the left foot just in front of the right for a wider base. Keep the hips facing forwards.
steps.zh: 伸直双腿，左脚稍放在右脚前方，扩大支撑。骨盆面向前，不要翻转。

steps.en: Gently brace and press the right forearm and edges of the feet into the mat to raise the pelvis.
steps.zh: 腹部稍收紧，右前臂和双脚边缘推垫，把骨盆抬起。

steps.en: Stop at a straight line through the head, trunk and legs. Keep the waist lifted and take quiet breaths without twisting the chest.
steps.zh: 从头、躯干到腿排成直线后停住。腰侧撑住，平缓呼吸，胸口不扭转。

steps.en: Lower the pelvis gently, rest, then practise on the left side with the same setup.
steps.zh: 骨盆轻轻落下，休息后换左侧，按同样方式就位。

cues.en: Lift the underside of the waist away from the mat.
cues.zh: 把下面那一侧腰带离垫子。

cues.en: Keep the shoulder away from the ear.

mistakes.en: Letting the pelvis sag. Why: the trunk bends sideways instead of resisting the pull of gravity.
mistakes.zh: 骨盆下沉。为什么：躯干开始侧弯，没有继续抵抗重力。

mistakes.en: Rolling the top shoulder forwards. Why: rotation changes the support and makes it harder to keep the pelvis aligned.
mistakes.zh: 上侧肩膀往前翻。为什么：旋转改变了支撑，也更难维持骨盆对齐。

text.en: Choose a knee-supported or straight-leg version that you can hold with comfortable breathing.
text.zh: 选能舒适呼吸的屈膝或直腿版本。

text.en: Practise both sides and add difficulty gradually instead of extending a hold after the waist drops.
text.zh: 两侧都练，逐步加难；腰侧已经塌下时，不要继续硬撑。

cautions.en: Stop for shoulder or back pain; change the support only if the new version is comfortable.
cautions.zh: 肩或背部疼痛就停下；改变支撑方式后，也要以舒适为前提。

cautions.en: First learn with bodyweight or a light load and guidance from a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Use a mat with space to reach forwards and backwards. Practise moving a hand or a leg alone before lifting an opposite pair if balance is difficult.
setup.zh: 在垫上留出前后伸展空间。平衡较难时，先只动一只手或一条腿，再尝试对侧肢体一起抬起。

steps.en: Start on hands and knees, hands under shoulders and knees under hips. Spread the fingers and look between the hands.
steps.zh: 四点跪撑，手在肩下、膝在髋下。手指张开，目光看两手之间。

steps.en: Keep a comfortable neutral back and gently firm the abdomen. Keep both sides of the pelvis level.
steps.zh: 腰背保持舒适的中立形状，腹部稍收紧，骨盆两侧同高。

steps.en: Reach the left hand forwards while sliding the right foot backwards, then lift them gradually. Keep weight through the right hand and left knee.
steps.zh: 左手向前伸，右脚向后滑，再慢慢把它们抬起。重量由右手和左膝支撑。

steps.en: Stop when the arm and leg are near the line of the trunk, or earlier if the back begins to arch. Breathe without turning the hips.
steps.zh: 手臂和腿接近躯干延长线就停；腰开始弓起时要更早停。保持呼吸，髋不转。

steps.en: Return the left hand and right knee softly to the mat. Reset, then change to the right hand and left leg.
steps.zh: 左手和右膝轻轻回垫，重新站稳，再换右手和左腿。

cues.zh: 往远处伸，不是往高处抬。

cues.en: Imagine a cup on the back of the pelvis staying level.
cues.zh: 想象骨盆后面放着一杯水，不让它晃倒。

mistakes.en: Kicking the leg high. Why: lumbar extension substitutes for the intended hip movement.
mistakes.zh: 把腿踢得很高。为什么：腰椎后伸替代了本应发生在髋的运动。

mistakes.en: Opening the hips towards the lifted leg. Why: the trunk rotates instead of resisting rotation as the limbs move.
mistakes.zh: 骨盆翻向抬起的腿。为什么：肢体移动时躯干跟着旋转，没有抵抗旋转。

text.en: Begin with short reaches or a limb kept on the floor until you can keep the pelvis steady.
text.zh: 先短距离伸展，或让一肢留在地面，练到骨盆稳定。

text.en: Progress the reach slowly and stop before you need to twist or arch to keep going.
text.zh: 逐渐伸远；需要扭身或弓腰才能继续时就结束。

cautions.en: Stop for wrist, knee or back pain; a folded mat may improve kneeling comfort, but do not work through pain.
cautions.zh: 手腕、膝或背部疼痛就停下；垫子折厚些可能让跪撑更舒适，但不要忍痛继续。

cautions.en: First learn with bodyweight or a light load and guidance from a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Use a secure overhead bar and a stable step for getting on and off. Learn supported standing knee raises first; do not start here if an overhead hang is painful or unstable.
setup.zh: 用牢固的单杠和稳固的上下台阶。先学扶稳站姿抬膝；悬垂会痛或撑不稳时，不从这个动作开始。

steps.en: Stand on the step and take a closed overhand grip about shoulder-width apart, thumbs around the bar.
steps.zh: 站在台阶上，以与肩大致同宽的正握握杠，拇指扣住杠。

steps.en: Lift the feet from the step into a quiet hang, elbows straight and shoulders controlled without forcing them down. Let the legs settle.
steps.zh: 双脚离开台阶，进入不摇晃的悬垂。肘伸直，肩部保持控制，不要强行压肩；先让腿停稳。

steps.en: Breathe out and bend the knees as you bring the thighs towards the trunk. Avoid swinging the feet forwards to begin.
steps.zh: 呼气，屈膝，把大腿带向躯干。起步时不要先向前甩脚。

steps.en: Near the top, gently curl the pelvis towards the ribs if you can do so without swinging. This adds abdominal work beyond hip flexion.
steps.zh: 接近顶端时，如果不摇晃，可以把骨盆轻轻卷向肋骨。除了屈髋，这会增加腹部控制骨盆的工作。

steps.en: Lower the pelvis and thighs slowly to a quiet hang. Finish by placing the feet back on the step before releasing the bar.
steps.zh: 骨盆和大腿慢慢放回，重新停稳。结束时先把脚放回台阶，再松杠。

cues.en: Lift the thighs, then make a small controlled pelvic curl.
cues.zh: 先抬大腿，再小幅、有控制地卷骨盆。

cues.en: Keep the bar and body quiet.

mistakes.en: Kipping to raise the knees. Why: momentum replaces controlled hip flexion and pelvic movement.
mistakes.zh: 摆荡借力抬膝。为什么：惯性替代了受控的屈髋和骨盆运动。

mistakes.en: Calling every knee lift a lower-ab curl. Why: raising the thigh alone is hip flexion; rectus abdominis contributes differently when the pelvis curls.
mistakes.zh: 把每次抬膝都当成下腹卷动。为什么：只抬大腿是屈髋，骨盆真正卷起时，腹直肌才承担不同的任务。

text.en: Use a smaller knee lift that leaves the hang quiet, and stop before the grip or shoulder position fails.
text.zh: 先小幅抬膝，保持悬垂安静；握力或肩部控制开始失效就结束。

text.en: Add range gradually after you can lower without swinging; supported practice can come first.
text.zh: 能不摇晃地放下之后，再逐渐扩大幅度；可以先做有支撑的练习。

cautions.en: Stop for shoulder pain, numbness, grip slipping or hip/back pain, and use the step to dismount.
cautions.zh: 肩痛、麻木、握不住，或髋背疼痛时停下，用台阶下杠。

cautions.en: First learn with bodyweight or a light load and guidance from a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Stand beside a fixed support on a non-slip floor. Use a light fingertip touch for balance, with room in front of the knee. The model rests both hands on two low rails.
setup.zh: 在防滑地面站到固定支撑物旁，用指尖轻扶保持平衡，膝前留出空间。模型双手扶在两根低横杆上。

steps.en: Stand tall with feet about hip-width apart and the right hand lightly on the support. Keep the ribs over the pelvis.
steps.zh: 双脚与髋大致同宽站直，右手轻扶支撑物，肋骨在骨盆上方。

steps.en: Shift weight gently onto the right foot without lifting the right hip towards the ribs. Keep the supporting knee soft.
steps.zh: 重量轻移到右脚，不把右侧髋提向肋骨，支撑膝不要硬锁。

steps.en: Breathe out and raise the left thigh with the knee bent. Stop around hip height, or earlier if the pelvis starts to tilt.
steps.zh: 呼气，屈左膝并抬左大腿。大约抬到髋高即可；骨盆开始歪时要更早停。

steps.en: Pause with the chest still upright and the pelvic rim level. Keep the foot relaxed rather than kicking forwards.
steps.zh: 短暂停住，胸口仍直立，骨盆上缘平稳。脚放松，不向前踢。

steps.en: Lower the left foot quietly to the start. Change sides and move the support to the other hand.
steps.zh: 左脚轻轻回到起点；换侧练习时，也换另一只手扶稳。

cues.en: Bring the thigh to the trunk while the trunk stays tall.
cues.zh: 大腿靠近躯干，躯干仍站直。

cues.en: Keep the two front hip points level.
cues.zh: 两侧髂前上棘保持同高。

mistakes.en: Leaning backwards to raise the knee. Why: changing the trunk angle hides the actual hip range and can arch the low back.
mistakes.zh: 为了抬膝而后仰。为什么：躯干角度变化掩盖了实际屈髋幅度，也可能让腰背弓起。

mistakes.en: Hiking the left side of the pelvis. Why: pelvic elevation substitutes for lifting the thigh at the hip.
mistakes.zh: 把左侧骨盆提起来。为什么：骨盆上提替代了大腿在髋关节处抬起。

text.en: Start with a comfortable height and enough support to keep the pelvis still.
text.zh: 先用舒适的高度和足够的支撑，让骨盆不动。

text.en: Improve smoothness and balance before adding resistance or more work.
text.zh: 先提高动作平稳度和平衡，再加阻力或训练量。

cautions.en: Stop for front-of-hip pinching or back pain. Use a fixed support that cannot roll or tip.
cautions.zh: 髋前方夹痛或背痛就停；支撑物必须固定，不会滚动或翻倒。

cautions.en: First learn with bodyweight or a light load and guidance from a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

name.zh: 绳索抗旋转推（帕洛夫推）

setup.en: Set a single pulley and handle at chest height with a light load. Stand with your right side facing the column; the cable should pull sideways rather than up or down.
setup.zh: 单侧滑轮和把手调到胸高，选轻重量。右侧朝向绳索柱，绳索应横向拉，不往上或往下拉。

steps.en: Hold the handle with both hands together, thumbs closed around the grip, and bring it to the centre of the chest.
steps.zh: 双手一起握住把手，拇指扣住握把，把手放到胸口中央。

steps.en: Step sideways away from the pulley until the cable is gently taut. Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart and knees soft.
steps.zh: 向侧面离开滑轮，直到绳索轻轻拉紧。双脚与肩大致同宽，膝盖稍松。

steps.en: Set the ribs over the pelvis and gently brace. Keep chest and pelvic front facing the same direction, at a right angle to the cable.
steps.zh: 肋骨在骨盆上方，腹部稍收紧。胸口和骨盆前面朝同一方向，与绳索拉力大致成直角。

steps.en: Breathe out and press the handle straight forwards to near-straight elbows, resisting the sideways pull without rotating.
steps.zh: 呼气，把把手直向前推到两肘接近伸直，同时抵抗横向拉力，不转身。

steps.en: Take a quiet breath, then bring the handle back to the chest slowly. To finish, move closer to the column until the stack settles; practise the other side.
steps.zh: 平缓呼吸，再慢慢把把手收回胸前。结束时走近绳索柱，让配重落稳，再换另一侧练习。

cues.en: Point the chest and belt buckle straight ahead.
cues.zh: 胸口和腰带扣始终朝正前方。

cues.en: Let the hands move; keep the torso still.

mistakes.en: Following the cable with the torso. Why: the exercise becomes a rotation instead of resisting rotation.
mistakes.zh: 躯干跟着绳索转。为什么：动作变成了旋转，没有继续抵抗旋转。

mistakes.en: Leaning sideways to counter the load. Why: the body uses a changed position rather than holding the intended upright trunk.
mistakes.zh: 向一侧歪身抵消重量。为什么：靠改变身体位置完成，没有维持原来的直立躯干。

text.en: Use a light pull that allows a smooth press with a quiet pelvis and comfortable breathing.
text.zh: 选轻到能平稳推出、骨盆不动且呼吸舒适的拉力。

text.en: Build control on both sides before moving farther from the pulley or adding load.
text.zh: 两侧都练会控制，再离滑轮更远或增加重量。

cautions.en: Keep fingers away from the pulley and stack, and return the handle under control before releasing it.
cautions.zh: 手指远离滑轮和配重，先有控制地把把手送回再松手。

cautions.en: Stop if the press causes shoulder or back pain.
cautions.zh: 推出时肩或背部疼痛就停下。

cautions.en: First learn with bodyweight or a light load and guidance from a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Clear a level walking path. Set a light dumbbell on a stable raised support so you can pick it up and put it down without rushing or twisting.
setup.zh: 清出平坦行走路线。轻哑铃放在稳固高台上，取放时不用急着弯身或扭腰。

steps.en: Stand beside the support and take the dumbbell in the right hand with a closed neutral grip. Stand tall before leaving the support.
steps.zh: 站到高台旁，右手以对握方向握哑铃，拇指扣住握柄。离开高台前先站直。

steps.en: Let the right arm hang by the thigh, elbow almost straight. Keep the left arm relaxed and shoulders at their natural height.
steps.zh: 右臂垂在大腿旁，肘接近伸直。左臂放松，两肩保持自然高度。

steps.en: Gently brace with the ribs over the pelvis. Begin walking with short quiet steps while looking ahead.
steps.zh: 腹部稍收紧，肋骨在骨盆上方。目光向前，用小而平稳的步伐开始走。

steps.en: Keep the trunk tall as each foot takes weight; do not lean towards or away from the dumbbell. Keep breathing normally.
steps.zh: 每次换脚承重，躯干仍保持直立，不向哑铃那侧或另一侧歪；保持自然呼吸。

steps.en: Stop before grip or posture fades, return the dumbbell to its support, and practise with the left hand on a clear path.
steps.zh: 握力或姿势开始变差前停下，把哑铃放回高台，再换左手走同样清楚的路线。

cues.en: Keep the belt buckle above the middle of the feet.
cues.zh: 腰带扣保持在双脚中间的上方。

cues.en: Carry the weight quietly beside the thigh.
cues.zh: 让重量安静地跟在大腿旁。

mistakes.en: Leaning away from the dumbbell. Why: the trunk bends sideways rather than maintaining the intended upright position.
mistakes.zh: 向哑铃另一侧歪身。为什么：躯干侧弯，没有维持原来的直立姿势。

mistakes.en: Rushing with a swinging dumbbell. Why: the changing pull makes balance and trunk control harder.
mistakes.zh: 走得太快，哑铃来回摆。为什么：拉力不断改变，平衡和躯干控制都更困难。

text.en: Choose a load that permits an upright walk and a secure grip on either side.
text.zh: 选两侧都能握稳、直立行走的重量。

text.en: Increase load or walking work gradually after the steps stay quiet, and recover between demanding efforts.
text.zh: 步伐稳定后，再逐渐增加重量或行走量；吃力的练习之间充分恢复。

cautions.en: Stop for back or shoulder pain, loss of balance, or grip slipping; put the weight down under control.
cautions.zh: 背痛、肩痛、失去平衡或握不住时停下，有控制地放下重量。

cautions.en: First learn with bodyweight or a light load and guidance from a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。
